description: Update a clockin absence, e.g. approve a vacation request (PATCH /absences/{id}). Required: id, changes (clockin requires employee_id, absencecategory_name, approval, starts_at, ends_at — fetch first). Approving or denying is a decision for a human.

changes.description: Fields to change (clockin expects the required fields of the object in every update)

absencecategory_name.description: vacation | sick | workshop | special_vacation | school | working_time_account | holiday | other | parental_leave | sick_child | … (siehe clockin-Doku)

name: update_clockin_absence
